title: 连接 GeoCiteOps
description: 填写工作区 API 令牌和部署地址。令牌只保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy，不会写进连接器包。
description_en: Enter the workspace API token and the deployment URL. The token stays in ~/.workbuddy on this machine.
docLabel: 如何创建 API 令牌？
docLabel_en: How do I create an API token?

fields.label: API 地址
fields.description: GeoCiteOps API 的 HTTPS 源站，不要带末尾斜杠。MCP 路径是 /mcp。
fields.description_en: HTTPS origin of the GeoCiteOps API, with no trailing slash. The MCP path is /mcp.

fields.label: API 令牌
fields.description: 控制台「API 凭证」里创建。只读令牌只能查报告。运行检查才会启动体检和付费模型调用。
fields.description_en: Create it under API credentials in the console. A read token can only fetch reports. Run checks starts health checks and paid model calls.
